propositions: Configuration schema fields in _config_schema.py may ship with zero read sites outside schema/config plumbing, causing knobs to silently do nothing.
An AST-level deterministic check is needed to require at least one attribute-read site (terminal-name match in Load context) for each schema field.
Fields with legitimately indirect reads (getattr dispatch, client-only knobs) must be marked with a '# read-via: <pointer-or-reason>' comment; bare markers are rejected.
The check fires only on zero references and must not trigger false positives on refactors or same-named fields across sections.
CI must fail and teach remediation when any schema field has zero read sites and lacks a valid read-via marker.
